items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: I don't know where it's located... But he's real hip... He plays modern -- he's got a good, big tone... I like that.

ctx.x: Peppy's -- it could have been, yes, (unintelligible). I don't know where it's located, but it's in the heart of town in Philadelphia, and Sports always talked about that, and it was his home town, you know. But he's real hip (unintelligible). He plays modern -- he's got a good, big tone, and he plays good ballads, and, of course, he plays good swing. And he plays He's on the beat. I like that.
